Initial release of enterprise-grade agentic document processing API.

- Accurately extracts key fields and line items from invoices, receipts, orders, and more across 10+ file formats (.jpeg, .png, .pdf, .docx, .xlsx, etc.) into structured JSON/Excel.
- Offers per-field confidence scores, async extraction for large documents, and access to VLM/LLM recognition results.
- Simple integration with zero configuration and environment variable support for credentials.
- Robust security guidance for handling sensitive documents and credential management.
- Free monthly usage credits for new users; commercial license required for continued use.
